description: This file contains React components and related types for building a filters UI in a Next.js frontend application. It includes components for structured select inputs, multi-select skills, salary slider, and filter tags, primarily used in a job or career navigation context.

classes.name: FiltersProps
classes.description: Props interface for the Filters component, defining selected filter values, options, and callback functions.

classes.name: ActiveFilterTagsProps
classes.description: Props interface for the ActiveFilterTags component, managing current filter tags and callbacks.

methods.name: FieldLabel
methods.description: Small label component for form fields.

methods.name: FieldShell
methods.description: Wrapper component for form field content.

methods.name: LoadingField
methods.description: Displays a skeleton loader for a form field during data loading.

methods.name: InlineError
methods.description: Component to display inline error messages related to loading errors.

methods.name: StructuredSelect
methods.description: Structured dropdown select component with sorting and filtering; used for job title and industry.

methods.name: MultiSelectSkills
methods.description: Multi-select component with search and tags for selecting skills.

methods.name: Filters
methods.description: Main filter UI component aggregating structured selects, skills multi-select, and a salary slider.

methods.name: ActiveFilterTags
methods.description: Component displaying active filter chips with individually removable tags and a clear all button.
